args.body:
- Brightline Freight's latest newsletter, "Cold-chain logistics in 2026," links to their article on the same topic.
- The article reports that temperature excursions fell 30% where carriers shared live sensor data, with most savings coming from fewer rejected loads rather than less spoilage.
- The companion piece adds that pilot programs cut claims by a quarter.
args.title: Brightline Freight: Cold-chain logistics in 2026 — summary
